newsitem.title: UK: IATA says 270 aircraft due for 1997 delivery..
newsitem.headline: IATA says 270 aircraft due for 1997 delivery..

text.p: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) said its 255 member airlines had 270 aircraft due for delivery in 1997 out of a total of 849 aircraft on order.
Over 47 percent of the outstanding aircraft are widebodies, IATA said in its latest World Air Transport Statistics (WATS) report.
It added that the average age of the total IATA fleet was 11.4 years in 1996 compared to 10.9 years the previous year with 15.7 percent (16 percent)of aircraft over 20 years old.
